column1: Note 1: For the special subframe configuration see table 4.2-1 in TS 36.211.Note 2: For the uplink-downlink configuration see table 4.2-2 in TS 36.211.Note 3:OCNG shall be used such that the resources in cell # 1 are fully allocated and a constant total transmitted power spectral density is achieved for all OFDM symbols.Note 4:The uplink resources for CQI reporting are assigned to the UE prior to the start of time period T1.Note 5:The timers and layer 3 filtering related parameters are configured prior to the start of time period T1.Note 6:   The signal contains PDCCH for UEs other than the device under test as part of OCNG.Note 7:   SNR levels correspond to the signal to noise ratio over the cell-specific reference signal REs.Note 8:    The SNR in time periods T1, T2 and T3 is denoted as SNR1, SNR2 and SNR3 respectively in figure A.7.3.3.1-1.
